\chapter{Sorting as a Tool}
\label{ch:sorting}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Sorting costs $\bigO{n \log n}$ once and makes neighbours meaningful: sort first, then scan, pair, group or rank.}}
\end{tcolorbox}

\chapterfacts{1000}{1800}{5}{10}{30}

\begin{plannedbox}[Planned Contents --- this chapter is not written yet]
\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item \texttt{std::sort}, stability and \texttt{stable\_sort}; what sorting buys: neighbours, monotonicity, binary search
    \item Comparators: strict weak ordering, sorting by several keys, sorting indices instead of values
    \item Non-comparison sorts: counting sort, bucket sort, radix sort and their limits (merge sort and quickselect are the recursion book)
    \item Ranks and coordinate compression in one line
    \item Sorting to minimise a cost: the median minimises absolute deviations, exchange arguments for orders
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Part B --- Patterns} (with the two solved problems of each pattern)
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{P\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item \textbf{Sort, then scan neighbours} --- Minimum Absolute Difference {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1200)}, Honest Coach {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 1360B)}
    \item \textbf{Custom comparators} --- Largest Number {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 179)}, Queue Reconstruction by Height {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 406)}
    \item \textbf{Counting and bucket sort} --- Relative Sort Array {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1122)}, Maximum Gap {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 164)}
    \item \textbf{Ranks and sorting by derived keys} --- Rank Transform of an Array {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1331)}, Sort Array by Increasing Frequency {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1636)}
    \item \textbf{The median and exchange arguments} --- Stick Lengths {\small\color{darkgray}(CSES 1074)}, Minimum Cost to Make Array Equal {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 2448)}
\end{enumerate}
\end{plannedbox}
